method.backend: Read-only TypeScript AST of tracked non-test source; resolve appRouter recursively, static runtime imports from API and worker. No application module execution, provider request or database call.
method.frontend: AST inventory of tracked client/src and shared runtime TypeScript, excluding test files; import reachability is not proof a conditional component executes.
method.projection: Join procedure IDs, static call locations and page import closure; keep guards as compact classifications/source locations, without input/output AST or handler source dumps.

limitations: Reachability proves an import path, not that every exported function executes.
Auth records retain builder/middleware and delegated guard evidence, not a complete symbolic authorization proof.
Frontend presence must be correlated separately; infrastructure does not imply missing UI.
Demo/provider/configuration gates can make a mounted procedure unavailable.
418/844 is not a product completion percentage; both denominator and numerator include infrastructure, conditional hooks and alternative clients.
Page association follows imports; it does not prove a conditional control renders or a user can discover a route.
Navigation matching may require manual confirmation of templates, account conditions, external email links and embedded entry points.
No new runtime acceptance, deployed configuration, database state or external-provider readiness is established by this baseline.
